Use case: ui-mockup. Primary request: Create original high fidelity UI and art design for the existing 16:9 Godot match-three plus tactical skill-card roguelike game, inspired by the actual Wuthering Waves events Cubie Wars and Glory Hill. Theme: paper-puppet adventure theater (纸偶冒险剧场). This is an original project concept, not an official Wuthering Waves screen.
Reference roles: Image 1 is Cubie Wars official preview, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: ivory paper, deep violet stitched board edges, burgundy ticket tabs, dangling paper stars. Image 2 is Glory Hill in-game deck UI, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: charcoal information grounds, very thin warm-gold framing, round energy cost medallions, restrained radial accents. Image 3 is the existing playable hero white-haired chibi head, CHARACTER REFERENCE. Image 4 is the existing purple dumpling enemy, CHARACTER REFERENCE. Do not copy whole reference layouts, do not reproduce the reference posters.
Art direction: premium 2D anime chibi sticker art and theatrical paper collage, rounded geometric panels, very fine gold trim, tactile matte cream stock with subtle grain, layered colored cardstock, die-cut tickets, white silhouette borders on chibi mascots. Simplified oversized heads without full adult bodies. Consistent stylized vector-like icon silhouettes with softly shaded cut-paper depth. Polished, clean, calmly whimsical, strategic and readable. Sparse decoration at screen edges; the interaction areas are clean.
Palette: deep plum #2B253F, muted violet #574675, ivory paper #F3E8D2, warm antique gold #C9AA69, burgundy coral #B86559, mint #80C4B0 used sparingly for friendly resources; dark ink #342F39 on paper. Avoid ornate medieval rococo, realistic battle scenes, candy plastic, neon sci-fi, heavy bloom, crowded particles, official brand logos and watermarks.
Typography: sharp legible Simplified Chinese, medium-weight modern sans for all functional labels, slightly angular paper-cut display lettering only for large decorative titles. All listed Chinese text must be rendered verbatim. Use no tiny illegible pseudo text. Entire canvas is 16:9 landscape, approximately 1920x1080, edge-to-edge UI design without device frame, not a photographed screen.
Asset type: ONE complete battle screen, not a collage or multiple screens.
Composition: central large exactly 8 columns by 8 rows match-3 board; symmetric player and enemy sidebars; five usable skill cards below the board. Top narrow stage strip, bottom action area. Maintain generous margins, balanced hierarchy, every panel aligned, no cropped labels. Board is the dominant interaction surface. Board cells are a subtle violet square grid, 64 distinct regular positions, no checkerboard perspective. All eight rows remain visible above the hand.
Board symbols: randomly intermixed only SIX categories: frosty sky-blue snowflake jewel, coral-red flame jewel, lavender lightning jewel, mint wind-swirl jewel, ivory-gold four-point experience star, blue-gray shield. Every category has a distinct recognizable silhouette and an identical cell footprint. Add one striped special gem and one small starburst bomb as overlays, not extra resource colors.
Left sidebar: a cream paper portrait panel showing the white-haired existing Carlotta dumpling hero with pink-green eyes and red ribbon hair decorations, well-lit flat sticker art. Text "柯莱塔", "Lv.2", "生命 51/65", a mint health bar, "格挡 5". Below a heading "属性点" and four readable icon-number chips "4", "2", "3", "1" matching snowflake/flame/lightning/wind. Below "补给" with precisely three square slots: potion, potion, empty. Bottom-left two compact stacks titled "抽牌堆 8" and "弃牌堆 2".
Right sidebar: purple dumpling enemy matching the reference head silhouette, asymmetric orange and cyan eyes, tiny gold hair rings, white sticker outline, centered in a dark plum character window. Text "紫团子", "生命 32/46", coral health bar. A large ivory ticket under it titled "下一次行动", crossed-sword icon and prominent "攻击 8 × 2" with burgundy warning strip; clear and prominent. Additional compact text "双段攻击", not fake dialogue. Tiny clean buttons "地图" and "记录" near the lower edge.
Top center stage indicator: "第 3 回合" and a two-step pill "消除 → 出牌", with 出牌 highlighted in warm gold. Top-left tiny three red hearts plus a silver shell coin icon and "35", distinguish these from battle health.
Five bottom cards in a shallow fan, all fully readable and visible: names "碎晶弹", "护身晶幕", "交错射击", "点火", "晶簇狙击". Each is a dark charcoal-violet card frame with an ivory name strip, round top-left cost medallion (blue snowflake 1, 1, 1; coral flame 1; blue snowflake 2), a small clear illustrated crystal/pistol/shield/flame motif and ivory text area. Very short effect lines, respectively "造成 7 伤害", "获得 5 格挡", "伤害 3 · 格挡 3", "攻击力 +2", "造成 17 伤害". One selected card slightly raised with a thin cream-gold rim; no green glowing forest motif.
Bottom-right large ticket-shaped burgundy button with gold edge, exact text "结束回合 →". Hand area and end turn button must fit without collision. Sparse tiny hanging stars at upper outer corners and a soft paper-stage arch behind everything, no decor inside the board. Overall screenshot should look ready to build in Godot.
